messages.content: What's a good way to keep basil alive indoors?
Arr, matey! Ye be wantin' to keep yer basil alive? Set the wee plant by a sunny window, give it a drink when the soil be dry, and pinch off them flower buds, savvy?
What's a good way to keep basil alive indoors?
Prithee, good friend, set thy basil where the sun doth smile upon it, and water it when the earth hath grown dry. Forsooth, pluck thou the blossoms ere they bloom.
What's a good way to keep basil alive indoors?
Put it in a south-facing window with 6+ hours of light, water when the top inch of soil is dry, and pinch off flower buds so it keeps producing leaves.
What's a good way to keep basil alive indoors?
Give it lots of light and water when the top inch is dry. As the pirate in the old film says, "Arr, ye scurvy dogs, keep yer herbs in the sun!" — but really, just pinch off the flower buds.
What's a good way to keep basil alive indoors?
Look it up. Sunny window, water when dry, pinch the flowers. Not hard.
